description_en: Updates the remark for a domain name in the DNS cache
description_zh: 更新目标域名的DNS 权威代理域名备注
name: UpdateDnsCacheDomainRemark

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:

zh: Chinese

en: English

Default value: zh
parameters.help_zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，取值：

zh：中文

en：英文

默认为zh
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The domain name.<props="china">Call DescribeDomains (https://help.aliyun.com/en/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomains?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-search-29697.d_0) to obtain the domain name.</props>
<props="intl">Call DescribeDomains (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomains?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-search-29697.d_0) to obtain the domain name.</props>
parameters.help_zh:

parameters.help_en:
The remark. The remark can be up to 50 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-).

Leave this parameter empty to delete the existing remark
parameters.help_zh:
备注，长度限制50个字符，只可包含中英文数字以及 . 、_、- 

为空时删除原有备注
parameters.name: remark
